image_urls.description: modern desk setup with remote collaboration tools

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure React JS files are used (.js / .jsx), build the frontend with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn/UI primitives, support both Team View (unguessable links + PIN protection) and Owner/Admin View (Usman and Hena logins + Google OAuth mock + financial/admin data), strict workflow enforcement (Assigned -> In Progress -> Pending Approval -> Completed, or Pending Approval -> Revision Required -> In Progress), data isolation for team members, robust testing with data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use full transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do not use generic Inter font for headings; use Outfit or similar expressive sans.
Include micro-interactions, smooth hover states, and proper toast notifications with Sonner.
Maintain strict server-side and client-side separation for financial and admin data.
